coach.title: About Your <red>COACH</red>
coach.name: John Doe
coach.bio: I won't just call myself your coach, consider me your brother. My goal is to help you reach the physique you dream of with love and ease, and to save you valuable time. Trust me, with or without a coach, you'll eventually get there—the only question is how long it will take. Know that I'm here to ensure you stay on the fastest, right track.

q1.question: What services do you provide?
q1.answer: I provide 100% customized training and nutrition plans tailored to your goals and daily routine (bulking - weight loss - rehabilitation) with 24-hour continuous follow-up.

q2.question: What is included in the medical follow-up package?
q2.answer: You will be in direct contact with specialized doctors who create your rehabilitation program, in case you are returning from a major injury like an ACL tear or orthopedic surgeries.

q3.question: What should I do after payment?
q3.answer: Send a screenshot to our WhatsApp number. Your subscription will be confirmed within 24 hours, and then I will ask you for all the details needed to accurately design your programs.

q4.question: When will I receive my program?
q4.answer: Your customized plan will be delivered within 1 to 3 days, and ready-made programs are delivered on the same day.
